2. It has been stated that the appellants filed Misc. Case No.101/2002 for will probate of the disputed property before District Delegate Khulna wherein. The opposite parties appeared and raised objection where upon the application for will probate was returned with direction to file suit in proper court. Thereafter the same was filed in the court of District Judge Khulna where in it was registered as T.S.01/2002. 

 7. Learned advocate for the appellants takes legal objection as to tiling of the application under order 38 rule 5 of the code of civil procedure by defendants Nos.1-3 and 5 (present respondents no.1-4) before court below (District Judge Khulna) which erroneously entertained such above application under order 38 rule 5 from above defendants Nos.1-3 and 5 for attachment of the suit property before judgment under obvious misconception of law in as much as the provisions under order 38 rule 5 code of civil procedure are available for the plaintiffs of any suit to seek relief for attachment of the suit property before judgment and the plaintiff of the suit shall specify the property required to be attached and the estimated value thereof. The provisions of order 38 rule 5 code of civil procedure are meant for direction by court upon defendants of any suit pending before court of furnish security or to produce at the disposal of the court the said property to be sufficient to satisfy the decree to be passed at the' conclusion of the hearing of the case afterwards. He therefore shows from above that defendants of the suit can have no scope to seek the aid of the provision of Order 38 rule 5 Code of Civil Procedure to obtain the impugned order from the court as above.
